sources.name: Datassential Most Loved Desserts (via Frozen Food Europe)
sources.method: poll of 2,531 US consumers, published Jun 2019, top 5 only (ice cream 90%, choc chip cookie 86%, ice cream sandwich, soft serve, ice cream cake)

sources.name: Verasight survey: 'true American dessert' (ICA Omnibus)
sources.method: poll of 1,000 US adults, Jun 25-30 2025, MoE +/-3.8; measures 'most American', not favorite

sources.name: Lovefood: America's most beloved desserts, ranked (21 items)
sources.method: editorial ranking ('unavoidably subjective'), excludes ice cream; 'American' desserts only

changes_vs_current: Mechanical result puts Apple Pie #1 and Ice Cream drops from #3 to #7 - this is an ARTIFACT: Lovefood's list omits ice cream, while Datassential (90%, #1), Verasight (#2) and older Yahoo 2015 (41%, #1 favorite) all put it at or near the top. Recommend manually keeping Ice Cream #1 or #2. Added Pecan Pie. Positions 12-24 (Tiramisu onward) have NO data and are carried over from the current list order (Milkshake dropped for space).
confidence: low - only 3 usable sources, and none is a full-list US favorites poll: one is top-5, one measures 'most American', one is a writer's ranking. Ranker dessert list (6.7K voters) blocked by HTTP 401; YouGov has no dessert-wide ranking (only ice cream truck treats and flavors). Treat positions 1-11 as indicative only and 12-24 as unverified.
